answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the jetty of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work. The pulse holds work receipts rather than names, so the karst of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
